line: Would you introduce me to one portfolio chief executive this month?
message:
I am working on a three week diagnostic pilot for leaders of PE-backed media businesses.
Would you be willing to introduce me to one chief executive in your portfolio who is deciding on AI this quarter?
It would help because the first pilots should come from people who already trust the work.
I can make this easy by sending a three-sentence note you can forward.
If it is not appropriate or you do not have capacity, please say so.
why: They sit on two portfolio boards and replied to your last piece.

stop: Stop after the easy-decline sentence. Do not explain the pilot again.
